title: Hokuleʻa 1980, reprinted in A Journey by the Stars
version: Congressional Record, 17 September 1980, p. 25908; reprint from Ka ʻElele, July 1980.
lineage: Contemporaneous participant report, republished in Congress. The reprint is not independent corroboration. Only the complete Kyselka item and introduction inspected, using a newly extracted identified original cached PDF; unrelated remarks not read. Raw fixes and the original newsletter not acquired. Introduction’s stars-only summary, accuracy averages and timeless universality are excluded.

passages.quote: changes in the rising and setting positions of stars
passages.note: Describes changing simulated latitude and investigating latitude cues.
